scpHelp: Keeps [Super Check Partial](https://www.supercheckpartial.com)'s list of calls active in contests on this device, about 8 MB, checked for updates once a day. Published by Mike Lyons, W9KKN.
scpDescription: Calls active in contests, from supercheckpartial.com
assistantDescription: Suggests the calls you could be typing, from your logs and Super Check Partial
panelDescription: Check typed calls against known calls
panelTypeMore: Type three or more characters of a call
panelUnsupported: This version of the app cannot search for calls
panelSomeMissing: Some sources didn't answer: calls may be missing
panelUnscored: Dupes and mults could not be checked
